The Bank of Korea
Monetary Policy Decision

The Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea decided
today to maintain the call rate target (uncollateralized overnight
rate) at its current level (4.50%) for the intermeeting period.

In the real economy, exports continue to show steady
growth, facilities investment exhibits a growing pace and the
recovery of construction investment has been maintained.

On the
other hand, private consumption exhibits a slowdown in the pace
of its expansion.

Meanwhile, the current account surplus has declined sharply,
owing mainly to the narrowed goods account surplus.
Consumer price inflation and core inflation both remain stable.
The upward pace of real estate prices has slowed down.

In the financial markets, financial institutions' lending has slowed
the pace of its expansion.

Nevertheless, overall liquidity conditions
are favorable.

Taking the above economic and financial conditions into
consideration, the Monetary Policy Committee of the Bank of Korea
decided today to maintain the call rate target (uncollateralized overnight
rate) at its current level (4.50%) for the intermeeting period.
